labels.title: Quick start
labels.intro: Set up the car wash in four steps. Everything is edited in these tables and saved in one go. Example data is a starting point: rename people, delete what you do not need, fix prices and rates.
labels.step1Help: Rename the sample employees, set each one's role and hourly salary rate (EUR), switch off or delete those you do not have. A role is a column in Quick Intake: the 'default employee' is who is pre-selected there.
labels.step2Help: One row per service. Open the row (the arrow) to see which works the service consists of, who does them and what each pays in EUR. The retail price is for private customers, the corporate price for contract customers.
labels.step3Help: A work is one unit of paid labour (e.g. 'Exterior wash'). The base rate is what the worker earns for it unless the service row sets its own rate. The role says who normally does it.
labels.rolesHelp: Each active role is a performer column in Quick Intake. Pick who is pre-selected for it.
labels.hintService:
Name: what the customer sees, e.g. 'Wash M'.
Retail price: EUR for a private customer. Corporate price: EUR for a contract customer (leave empty if the same).
Minutes: how long the car is on the bay - used by the booking calendar and the on-bay timer.
Open the row and add the works: who does what. A rate left empty means the work's base rate (step 3).
labels.noWorksYet: No works yet - add them below.
labels.addWorkToService: Add a work to this service
labels.rateHelp: Empty rate = the base rate of the work (grey hint). A rate here applies only to this service.
labels.checkSavedOnly: Only saved data is checked: save your changes first, then re-check.
